## ✨ Added

- **An AppImage for Linux,** for amd64 and arm64, beside the installer and the Flatpak. It runs without installing anything, and the built-in updater replaces the AppImage file it was started from. The download buttons in the README and under Browser tools name the architecture, the AppImage comes before the Flatpak, and the macOS button says Apple and Intel.

## 🎨 Design

- **KnightLoader follows GlimStone 4.7.0.** Many more VPN, captcha and MCP client tiles show the provider's own mark from GlimStone's catalog. Sign-ins at sites and hosters stand as compact connection rows with the logo, one quiet status line and Sign in here, Test, Edit and Remove at the end. On a phone the buttons keep to their glyphs.
- **A disabled download sits on a darker band** that follows the shading level under Settings, Appearance, and the alternating stripes stay visible around it. On a dark theme the band stays grey. The files of a disabled torrent get the same band. Suggested by @MueChris82 ([#177](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/issues/177)).

## 🐛 Fixed

- **A free Rapidgator download with a Turnstile captcha starts after the countdown.** Rapidgator only accepts an answer that is still fresh when the link is fetched, and KnightLoader asked for it after the countdown, so the answer often came too late and Rapidgator put a wait of an hour or two on the account. The captcha is asked during the countdown, and when Rapidgator still refuses, the log says why. Reported by @MueChris82 ([#308](https://github.com/junkerderprovinz/knightloader/issues/308)).
- **The download list shows up right after an update in Firefox.** After a few failed attempts at the same address, as happen while the container restarts, Firefox holds a new live connection back for up to a minute, and the list said nothing was downloading all that time. Until the live connection is up, the list comes over plain requests every two seconds.

## 🌐 Translations

- **Every new and changed text is in all 42 languages** of the web interface.
